observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: Television studio, morning news program, 'Dance Party Friday' segment.
observation.dancers: Four people: two men and two women, dancing in a group.
observation.formation_and_space: A single line, facing the camera, moving in place.
observation.posture: Upright torso, knees slightly bent, weight shifts between feet.
observation.footwork: Basic step pattern: step back, step in place, step forward, step in place. The steps are on the beat. The low-resolution video makes it difficult to see the exact weight transfer.
observation.arms_and_hands: Arms move in coordination with the steps, often in a 'chicken wing' motion, or held at chest height, sometimes clapping.
observation.hips_and_torso: Minimal torso movement, some slight hip swaying.
observation.partnering: None; the dancers are in a line and do not touch.
observation.costume_and_props: Casual, festive attire: sequined jackets, patterned tops, and trousers.
observation.cannot_infer: The low-resolution video makes it difficult to see the exact weight transfer or the precision of the footwork.

signature_moments.what: The basic step: step back with one foot, step in place with the other, step forward with the first foot, step in place with the second.
The 'chicken wing' move: elbows bent and raised, hands near the shoulders, moving in a rhythmic, flapping motion.
The 'roll it out' move: arms extended and rotating around each other in front of the chest.
